title: Clearing, length, and iteration
requirements: 12.02. `clear()` does not reset the next sequence.
12.03. Appending after `clear()` does not reuse an earlier sequence number.
12.04. `__len__()` returns the number of currently retained entries.
12.05. `__iter__()` returns entries in retained journal order.
12.06. An iterator already returned is unaffected by later append, eviction, restoration, or clearing operations.
12.07. Stable iteration is implemented through an independent snapshot of the retained container.
